name: Ares
description:
ares is an open-source multi-system emulator with a primary focus on accuracy, preservation, and clean architectural design. Originally developed by Near as a continuation of higan, ares emulates dozens of classic video game consoles and handhelds with cycle-accurate precision.

Features:
- Cycle-accurate emulation for Nintendo 64, PlayStation, SNES, NES, and Game Boy
- Support for Sega Genesis, Mega CD, 32X, Master System, and Game Gear
- PC Engine / TurboGrafx-16, Neo Geo Pocket, WonderSwan, and arcade systems
- Advanced video filtering, shaders, and low-latency audio processing
- Robust controller configuration with modern gamepad and force feedback support
